rules.I1: Controls: four moves (up, down, left, right).
rules.I2: Ice sliding: after a move the player keeps sliding in that direction until the next cell is a wall, water or a crate that cannot move.
rules.I3: Pushing: sliding into a crate pushes it, and the player and crate slide together until the crate hits an obstacle; both stop, the player next to the crate.
rules.I4: Chains: a pushed crate that runs into another crate pushes that crate too; the whole row moves together.
rules.I5: Water blocks the player: the player cannot enter water and stops in front of it.
rules.I6: A crate pushed into water fills it: the crate disappears, the water becomes walkable floor, and the player can then slide across it.
rules.I7: Win: the player must come to rest (stop) on the goal tile; sliding over the goal does not complete the level.

rules.K1: Controls: four moves plus an action button (ACTION5) that confirms a choice.
rules.K2: Walls block the player; orange (normal) crates are pushed one cell Sokoban-style and cannot be pushed into walls or crates.
rules.K3: Red crates jump like a chess knight: walking into a red crate moves the player into its cell, and the crate can land two cells further in the push direction and one cell to either side (an L-shaped move).
rules.K4: A red-crate landing cell must be empty (no wall, crate or player); if no landing cell is free the move is refused.
rules.K5: Choosing: the possible landing cells are shown (dark red); while choosing, the move keys switch which landing cell is selected and the player does not move.
rules.K6: The action button (ACTION5) confirms: the red crate is placed on the selected landing cell and normal play resumes.
rules.K7: Win: the level is completed when every target (dark blue tile) is covered by a crate of either kind.

rules.M1: Controls: four moves (up, down, left, right). There is no use for an action button.
rules.M2: Walking into a crate pushes it one cell (Sokoban push); crates cannot be pulled.
rules.M3: A crate cannot be pushed into another crate or off the grid; the push is refused.
rules.M4: Floor colour restricts the player: a step from a white (light) tile onto a black (dark) tile, or from black onto white, is refused.
rules.M5: Grey tiles connect both colours: the player can step onto grey from white or black, and from grey onto white or black.
rules.M6: Pushing also depends on floor: a player on white/grey can push only a crate standing on white/grey, a player on black only a crate standing on black; otherwise the push is refused.
rules.M7: The crate itself is not restricted by colour: a pushed crate may move onto any floor colour (which changes who can push it next).
rules.M8: Win: when every crate is on a target (blue tile) the level is completed and the next level loads.
